**Minecraft 26.x | Fabric and NeoForge**

Proof-of-concept of an alternative Villager Trading mechanic using a teaching system, to encourage exploration and reduce random grind. Teach librarians, weaponsmiths, toolsmiths, armourers, and fletchers by selling them enchanted items — they'll learn and resell what you teach!

Install one of these to your server's `mods/` folder (or run Open To LAN on a singleplayer world)

- `tradeschool-fabric-${VERSION}.jar` — Fabric (requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api))
- `tradeschool-neoforge-${VERSION}.jar` — NeoForge

TL;DR:

1. Find a decent enchanted book, enchanted weapon, armour, or even just make a basic pickaxe;
2. Hold it and right-click a suitable Villager (eg. Weaponsmith, Librarian, etc.) and sell it to them
3. The Villager should now be able to sell identical items; however, if they are low-skill eg. novice, it will limit the materials and enchantments they can make.
